title: 第4章 李叶盛
content_zh:
第4章 李叶盛
“大伯饶命啊！”
那人吓得胆裂，一落地就开始求饶，抱着李木田缩成了一团。
“啊！饶命，大伯饶命，大伯饶命啊…”
李叶盛怎么也没想到自己只想偷枚瓜解解馋，眨眼间自己最怕的这位大伯就站在了面前，吓得他动弹不得，谁知李木田一手还提着长刀，更叫他肝胆俱裂。
“叶盛？”李木田定睛瞧了瞧，皱紧了眉头，脸上阴晴不定，摸着下巴的胡须定定地望着他。
李叶盛是李叶生的哥哥，他俩的父亲长年卧病在床，李叶盛却成日里游手好闲，四处打秋风。
两个少年也闻声赶来，李通崖长棍一抬，径直压在李叶盛的臂膀上，吓得他涕泪横流。李长湖拎起他的脑袋一瞧，不禁动容。
“堂弟？”李长湖长出一口气，疑惑地问出声。
“你为何在这儿？”李通崖冷冷地问着，手上的长棍力道不减。
“偷你家瓜来了！”看着李叶盛支支吾吾的样子，李木田冷着脸替他回答，手中长刀一收，扭头就走。
“堂弟，得罪了。”
李通崖也收力提棍，甩下一句话便跟着父亲回屋了。只剩下李长湖将扶起李叶盛，替他擦了脸，又温言抚慰了几句，客气送出了庭院。
————
李尺泾和李项平呆呆地坐在桌边，鉴子藏在怀里，李项平一动也不敢动，好在不多时父亲二哥就走进了堂中。
“大哥呢？”
他望望他们的身后，赶忙问。
“送客去了。”
李木田摇了摇头
“叶盛这孩子时常来打秋风我晓得，可生怕今晚的事走漏了风声，叫全家飞灰烟灭。”

李通崖找到了小凳坐下，闻言偏头望了望李项平，正欲开口。
“嘎吱。”
大门发出合闭声，大哥李长湖神色疑惑，往凳子上一坐，对着父亲李木田开口。
“父亲这是何必？”
他摇了摇头。
“叶盛不过偷一枚瓜罢了，您这顺水人情不做，偏偏要得罪他家。”
“什么他家我家，只有一个李家，我嫡尔庶”
李木田靠着窗侧着耳，对着妇人和幼子招招手：“你们蹲去正门后门，有人便叫唤。”
两人应是，便退出去了，李木田转身关死门窗，拍了拍李项平道
“你说！”
李项平用力点点头，小小声地开口:
“今日我去眉尺河抓鱼，从河里捡着个物什。”
言罢望了望父亲李木田，见他一点头，从怀里掏出枚鉴子来。
李长湖望望弟弟，又看看父亲，接过那枚青灰色鉴子，细细打量也没看出个所以然来。
李木田从长子手中接过鉴子，寻了屋顶那处小洞，挪了个石凳，将鉴子往其下一放，眯眼望着两个儿子。
眼看月光如水般波动不断，又如乳燕投林般汇聚在镜面上方，浮现出一抹淡白色的如同宝石般的月晕来。
李长湖“噌”地从椅子上站起，死死地盯着鉴子上的月晕，李通崖也失色动容，若有所思地盯着鉴子。
整整沉默了一盏茶的时间，李家众人默默地盯着鉴子一眼不发，神色各异。
李项平已经是第二次看这副画面，却也震惊失色，喃喃自语:
“我自小未见过这般美景…”

“哈哈别说你了，你老子我也不曾见过这样好的东西。”
李木田低笑着，却不见什么笑意，反倒眼神狠厉。
“这恐是仙人之物。”
李通崖静静地开口，拿起长刀不断擦拭，他盯着鉴子状似平静，不断颤抖的手却出卖了他的内心。
“走漏风声，亦是我家灭门之祸。”
李长湖在堂中里不断踱步，神色焦虑又兴奋。
“若是仙人丢失之物，明日便施法寻来，我等如何自处？”
李通崖定定地盯着父亲，不无忧虑地说。
李项平点点头，笑着说：“仙人会赏赐些什么，我家都受用无穷。”
“放屁。”
李木田摆摆手“我听闻仙人多有嗜杀之辈，万万不可！这鉴子落水中不知多久，要来取早便拾去了，那轮得到我等凡人，我看那仙人多半已经遭遇不测。”
这大逆不道的话听得李长湖心惊胆战，皱着眉头也不知在想些什么。
李通崖却恍然大悟，低沉沉地开口：
“可是被李叶盛那小子见去了？”
“我在屋前给父亲看了此物，当时叶盛哥应在田里。”李项平低垂着眉眼。
“我去杀了他！”
李通崖表情狠厉，毫不犹豫地披起藤衣，拿起刀就往外走，李项平头次在哥哥脸上瞧见这种神色，不禁多看了两眼。
“回来！”李木田皱着眉叫住李通崖，撇了李项平一眼，看得他神色慌张。
“父亲！”李通崖终于急了，他语气强硬地开口。
“李叶盛此人薄情寡义，张扬无度却又吃里扒外，与其让他失言放出去风声引来我李家灭门之灾，不如让他先死一步。”

“看来二哥跟村里的先生学到了不少东西。”李项平默默地想，羞愧地低下头，父亲当年送三人跟着读书，两位哥哥都得了先生喜欢。唯有自己年少无知调皮捣蛋，现在竟听不懂哥哥话中的成语。
“那若是你幼弟吃里扒外，嘴上不严，你也一并杀了？”
李木田哈哈一笑，反问自己的次子。
“咱家没有这样的孬种”
李通崖淡淡地说。
李木田摇摇头，抬手将木桌移正，纵身一跃，在桌上轻轻一点，从屋梁上抽出一块木盒来。
将木盒放在桌面上，他正色对面前的三兄弟道：
“有些事也叫你们知道，我十三岁离乡，沿着古黎道进了安黎县。杨将军接了朝廷命令攻打山越，在古黎道征兵，当时你爹我无处容身，只好当了兵。”
“杨将军治军严明，却也与我等同食同住，亲如一家。他传了我等越兵战法，叫我等好好练武。这战法流传甚广，易学难精，寻常人练成了也不过身手矫健，不见有甚神异处。”李木田叹了口气，见几人听得很是认真，继续说着：
“我回乡后读书写字，将战法默写在这木简中，已经叫你等仔细练习过了，如今也不见得有什么名堂，这是其一。”
(本章完)

Chapter 4 Li Yesheng
"Uncle, please forgive me!"
The man was so frightened that he began to beg for mercy as soon as he landed on the ground, and huddled up while hugging Li Mutian.
"Ah! Have mercy on me, uncle, have mercy on me, uncle, have mercy on me..."
Li Yesheng never thought that he just wanted to steal a melon to satisfy his greed. In the blink of an eye, the uncle he was most afraid of stood in front of him, and he was so frightened that he could not move. Unexpectedly, Li Mutian was holding a long knife in one hand, which made his liver and gallbladder split.
"Ye Sheng?" Li Mutian took a closer look, frowned, his face was uncertain, and he looked at him steadily while stroking the beard on his chin.
Li Yesheng is Li Yesheng's brother. Their father has been bedridden for many years, but Li Yesheng spends his days doing nothing, playing in the autumn wind.
Two teenagers also heard the sound and came over. Li Tongya raised his long stick and pressed it directly on Li Yesheng's arm, scaring him to tears. Li Changhu picked up his head and took a look, and couldn't help but feel moved.
"Cousin?" Li Changhu took a deep breath and asked doubtfully.
"Why are you here?" Li Tongya asked coldly, the strength of the long stick in his hand not diminishing.
"They're here to steal your melons!" Seeing Li Yesheng hesitating, Li Mutian answered for him with a cold face, put away the long knife in his hand, turned around and left.
"Cousin, I'm offended."
Li Tongya also put back his strength on the stick, said a few words and followed his father back to the house. Only General Li Changhu was left to help Li Yesheng up, wiped his face, said a few words of comfort and politely sent him out of the courtyard.
————
Li Chijing and Li Xiangping sat blankly at the table, with the jianzi hidden in their arms. Li Xiangping did not dare to move. Fortunately, his father's second brother walked into the hall not long after.
"Where's eldest brother?"
He looked behind them and asked quickly.
"Going to see off guests."
Li Mutian shook his head
"I know that kid Ye Sheng often comes here to beat the autumn wind, but I'm afraid that the news of what happened tonight will leak out and the whole family will be wiped out."
Li Tongya found a small stool and sat down. Hearing this, he turned his head and looked at Li Xiangping, about to speak.
"Crunch."
The door made a closing sound. The eldest brother, Li Changhu, looked puzzled. He sat down on the stool and spoke to his father, Li Mutian.
"Father, why is this necessary?"
He shook his head.
"Ye Sheng just stole a melon. If you don't do this favor, you will offend his family."
"What about his family and my family? There is only one Li family, and I am a legitimate concubine."
Li Mutian leaned against the window and tilted his ear, waving to the woman and young son: "You squat down at the front and back doors. If someone calls, you will."
The two responded and exited. Li Mutian turned around and closed the door and window, patted Li Xiangping and said
"Say it!"
Li Xiangping nodded vigorously and spoke in a low voice:
"Today I went to Meichi River to catch fish and picked up something from the river."
After saying this, he looked at his father Li Mutian, saw him nodding, and took out a jianzi from his arms.
Li Changhu looked at his younger brother, then at his father, and took the blue-gray Jianzi. He looked at it carefully and couldn't figure out the reason.
Li Mutian took the Jianzi from his eldest son, looked for the small hole in the roof, moved a stone bench, put the Jianzi under it, and squinted at his two sons.
Seeing the moonlight fluctuating like water, and converging on the mirror like a swallow in the forest, a pale white gem-like moon halo emerged.
Li Changhu stood up from his chair and stared at the moon halo on the jianzi. Li Tongya also lost color and stared at the jianzi thoughtfully.
For a whole cup of tea, everyone in the Li family stared at Jianzi silently with different expressions.
This was the second time Li Xiangping saw this scene, but he was also shocked and murmured:
"I have never seen such beautiful scenery since I was a child..."
"Haha, stop talking about you, I have never seen such a good thing."
Li Mutian smiled lowly, but there was no smile at all. Instead, his eyes were fierce.
"This is probably something from an immortal."
Li Tongya spoke quietly, picked up the long knife and kept wiping it. He seemed calm as he stared at the jianzi, but his trembling hands werebetrayed his heart.
"If the news leaks out, it will also bring disaster to my family."
Li Changhu kept pacing in the hall, looking anxious and excited.
"If it is something lost by the immortal, and I will use magic to find it tomorrow, how will we deal with it?"
Li Tongya stared at his father steadily and said worriedly.
Li Xiangping nodded and said with a smile: "My family will benefit from whatever the immortal will reward me."
"Fart."
Li Mutian waved his hand, "I heard that many immortals are bloodthirsty, so you must not do it! I don't know how long it took for this mirror to fall into the water. I picked it up when I came to pick it up. Then it will be our turn to be mortals. I think that the immortal has probably met with something unexpected."
Hearing these treacherous words, Li Changhu was frightened and frowned, not knowing what he was thinking.
Li Tongya suddenly realized it and spoke in a low voice:
"But was he seen by that boy Li Yesheng?"
"I showed this thing to my father in front of the house. Brother Ye Sheng was in the field at that time." Li Xiangping lowered his eyebrows.
"I'm going to kill him!"
Li Tongya had a stern expression on his face. He put on his rattan clothes without hesitation, picked up the knife and walked out. This was the first time Li Xiangping saw this look on his brother's face, and he couldn't help but take a second look.
"Come back!" Li Mutian called to Li Tongya with a frown, and glanced at Li Xiangping, making him look panicked.
"Father!" Li Tongya finally became anxious and spoke forcefully.
"Li Yesheng is a person who is unsympathetic and unrighteous. He is flamboyant but also picks up on others. Rather than let him make a mistake and let the news spread, which will lead to the disaster of destroying my Li family, it is better to let him die first."
"It seems that the second brother has learned a lot from the gentleman in the village." Li Xiangping thought silently and lowered his head in shame. His father sent the three of them to study with him, and both brothers were liked by the gentleman. Only I was ignorant and naughty when I was young, and now I can't understand the idioms in my brother's words.
"Then if your little brother eats the inside and outside and talks laxly, will you kill him too?"
Li Mutian laughed and asked his second son.
"There is no such coward in our family"
Li Tongya said lightly.
Li Mutian shook his head, raised his hand to straighten the wooden table, jumped up, tapped lightly on the table, and pulled out a wooden box from the beam.
Putting the wooden box on the table, he said seriously to the three brothers in front of him:
"I also want you to know something. I left my hometown when I was thirteen and entered Anli County along the Guli Road. General Yang received the imperial order to attack Shanyue and recruited troops on Guli Road. At that time, your father and I had no place to live, so we had to become soldiers."
"General Yang is strict in running the army, but he also eats and lives with me, and we are as close as a family. He taught us the Vietnamese soldiers' fighting methods and told us to practice martial arts well. This fighting method is widely spread, easy to learn and difficult to master. Ordinary people can only practice it with strong skills, and there is nothing magical about it." Li Mutian sighed, and saw that several people were listening very seriously, and continued:
"After I returned to my hometown, I read and wrote. I wrote down my fighting skills silently on this wooden slip. I have asked you to practice them carefully. Now I don't necessarily have any tricks up my sleeve. This is one of them."
(End of chapter)
